final: WITH t AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, HGB, `T-BIL` / CRE AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date > '1985-04-22' AND Date < '1994-03-14'), g AS (SELECT status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM t GROUP BY status), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.overall AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.overall IS NOT NULL
